questions.question: What is the mood of Psalm 6?
options: A song of triumph after victory
A meditation on the law of God
A plea for mercy in distress
A hymn of praise for creation
questions.answer: A plea for mercy in distress

questions.question: How does David describe his weariness?
options: He floods his bed with tears every night
He keeps silent and hides his grief
He fasts in sackcloth for many days
He cries aloud in the city streets at noon
questions.answer: He floods his bed with tears every night
